fields.statement: Scratch build: a hand-edited log entry holding a braced reference to a forged 26-character ID made rhiza check exit 1 with 'fail text-ref ... victim field statement holds @{01ZZ...}, which names no node'; a kept reference to a retired node gave a warn with check still ok; hand-written '@{ID}' gave nothing. On this repo at the branch head with a fresh cache, rhiza check reports no text-ref finding (cycle-1 f1 fixed); its only fails are stale rendered actor/index files from the verifiers' evidence commits, which the run's gate render regenerates
